steps.name: feed-lib
steps.summary: src/lib/feed.ts: groupFeed<T extends {paidLocalDate,createdAt}>(rows, roomStartDate|null)→FeedSection<T>[]{key(날짜|'pre-trip'),title,data}, dateTitle('YYYY-MM-DD')→'10월 21일 (수)', payerRecorderLabel(payer,recorder); src/lib/history.ts: type Snapshot(_expense_snapshot의 snake_case 키), diffSnapshots(prev|null,next,names: Record<memberId,name>)→string[] ('처음 기록'/'삭제'/'복구'/금액·통화·결제일·가맹점·결제자·대상 인원·박스 추가/삭제/금액/지정)

steps.name: realtime-hooks
steps.summary: src/services/api.ts: feed(roomId)→FeedRow[]{id,merchant,paidLocalDate,paidLocalTime,createdAt,currency,amountOriginal,krwAmount,fxSource,source,payerKind,payerMemberId,createdBy(profile id),needsReview}, expense(id)→ExpenseDetail(expenses 행+expense_items[position순]{item_assignees}+expense_scope+expense_photos, snake_case), expenseHistory(id)→HistoryRow[]{id,action,actorId,actorNickname,at,snapshot:Snapshot}, deleteExpense(id,expectedVersion), reconfirmPendingFx(roomId)→number (expensePayload는 expense() 재사용); src/hooks/useRealtimeRoom.ts(채널 room:{id}, 무효화만, 재구독·AppState active 시 ['room',id] 전체 무효화) → app/(app)/rooms/[roomId]/_layout.tsx에서 호출; src/hooks/useFeed.ts useFeed(roomId) ['room',id,'feed']; src/hooks/useExpense.ts useExpense(id) ['expense',id], useExpenseHistory(id) ['expense',id,'history'], useDeleteExpense() mutate({roomId,id,expectedVersion}); 무효화 키: comments→['expense',expense_id,'comments'], members→['room',id,'members'], transfers→['room',id,'transfers'], pool→['room',id,'pool'], room_events→['room',id,'events']

steps.name: feed-screen
steps.summary: app/(app)/rooms/[roomId]/index.tsx: SectionList(groupFeed, room.startDate)+RefreshControl, 배너(작성 중 1건·환율 대기 N건→useReconfirmPendingFx), 오프라인 띠(feed.error.code==='OFFLINE'), 카드 탭→router.push('/rooms/[roomId]/expenses/[expenseId]', {roomId, expenseId}) (상세 화면은 step 3); src/components/ExpenseCard.tsx ExpenseCard({row:FeedRow,payerName,recorderName,payerColorIndex,payerGuest?,onPress}) FadeIn 200ms; src/hooks/useFeed.ts useReconfirmPendingFx(roomId).mutate(pendingRows) = (결제일,통화)별 api.fxRate allSettled → api.reconfirmPendingFx → ['room',id]·['rooms'] 무효화

steps.name: expense-detail
steps.summary: app/(app)/rooms/[roomId]/expenses/[expenseId].tsx: 상세(서명 URL 썸네일→Modal+ScrollView maximumZoomScale 확대, 박스·결제자/기록자·대상 인원·fxBasisLabel, pending이면 열 때 useReconfirmPendingFx 1회 후 ['expense',id] 무효화, [수정]→review?edit={id}&version={n}, [삭제]→BottomSheet 확인→useDeleteExpense→router.back, 수정 이력=actorNickname·historyStamp + diffSnapshots, 댓글 자리 주석만); src/lib/expenseForm.ts draftFromExpense(SaveExpensePayload)→ExpenseDraft(api.expensePayload 결과 사용, manual_rate는 draft에 없음); src/lib/history.ts historyStamp(iso)→'10/22 21:14'; src/hooks/useExpense.ts useUpdateExpense().mutateAsync({payload,expectedVersion}) ['room',roomId]·['expense',id]·['rooms'] 무효화(clearDraft 안 함); review.tsx 편집 모드: 메모리 state(editing{draft,version}), 중복 배너 숨김, VERSION_CONFLICT면 문구+api.expensePayload로 draft·version 갱신; useReconfirmPendingFx 인자를 Pick<FeedRow,'paidLocalDate'|'currency'>[]로 완화
